description: This Java source file defines a REST controller for managing user notifications in a Learning Management System backend. It provides endpoints for retrieving recent notifications and streaming real-time notifications via Server-Sent Events (SSE).

classes.name: NotificationController
classes.description: A REST controller handling notification-related endpoints, including fetching recent notifications and establishing SSE streams for real-time updates.

methods.name: recent
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch the most recent notifications for the authenticated user.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Handles GET requests to establish a Server-Sent Events stream for real-time notifications, supporting both standard and fallback authentication methods.
